effects.name: processing-outcome-write
effects.system: Portal Operational Store SQLite database, through operational-store@4
effects.detail: Completes the held Processing Job with one interpretation outcome, and its Canonical Revision when there is one, under the lease's fence; an identical outcome already recorded under its key is returned, not appended; a refusal or retryable failure commits nothing.

effects.name: processing-failure-write
effects.system: Portal Operational Store SQLite database, through operational-store@4
effects.detail: Closes the held attempt with one transient or deterministic failure and a health-data-free reason under the lease's fence, re-queuing the job after its backoff or failing it; a refusal or retryable failure commits nothing.
